senses.gloss: pr. n. (= מטרטרון, redupl. of נטר, v. מַטָּרָא) [Chief of the Service,] Mattatron (Mittatron), name of the chief of the angels (corresp. to שר הפנים).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 5:24">Targ. Y. I Gen. V, 24</cite> <he>מי׳ ספרא רבא</he> M., the chief recorder.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:19">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 24:1">Ex. XXIV, 1</cite>, cmp. Targ. Y. a. l.) <he>זה מ׳ וכ׳</he> that is M. whose name is like that of his master (with ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:21">Ex. XXIII, 21</cite>, cmp. Rashi a. l.).
<cite ref="Chagigah 15a:5">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>חזא מט׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. repeatedly <he>מי׳</he>) saw M. to whom permission was given to be seated while writing down &c.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3b:12">Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>איבעית אימא מט׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מי׳</he>) if you choose, say it was M. (that instructed the children). Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) <he>בא מ׳ ונפל וכ׳</he> M. came and fell upon his face.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 338:3">Sifré Deut. 338</cite> [read:] <he>באצבעו היה מ׳ מראה וכ׳</he> with his (Moses’) finger Metatron pointed out to Moses &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 949:1">Yalk. ib. 949</cite> (v. <cite ref="M01127"><he>מִיטָטוֹר</he></cite>). [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:4">Gen. R. s. 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01127"><he>מִיטָטוֹר</he></cite>.]
